title: Suction gripping device, transfer system, and transfer method

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The pressure regulator 51 includes a pump, an ejector, a vacuum pump, a pressure regulator valve, a pressure gauge, etc., and regulates the internal pressure of the suction pad 11 via the tube 50 and the pipe 12 .
features.note: The reference discloses a pressure regulator that includes a vacuum pump, which is an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
features.refuted: The quote describes a pressure regulator, not an electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The suction pad 11 has an attachment surface 11 a and is vacuum-attachable to the surface of the workpiece to be gripped.
features.note: The reference discloses a suction pad with an attachment surface, which functions as a seal, but does not explicitly mention a separate carrier plate.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: The suction gripping device 100 according to the embodiment includes a pad mechanism 1 , a base 30 , a lock controller 40 , a lock control driver 41 , a tube 50 , a pressure regulator 51 , a
features.note: The suction gripping device combines a pad mechanism (which includes the suction pad) and other components, implying a combined vacuum handling apparatus.
features.refuted: The quote is incomplete and does not establish that a grip unit and suction plate are combined.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
features.note: The reference describes a suction gripping device with a pad mechanism, but does not explicitly state that the grip unit and suction plate are releasably connected via a coupling device.

features.item: Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: The pressure regulator 51 includes a pump, an ejector, a vacuum pump, a pressure regulator valve, a pressure gauge, etc., and regulates the internal pressure of the suction pad 11 via the tube 50 and the pipe 12 .
features.note: The reference describes the pressure regulator regulating the internal pressure of the suction pad via a tube and pipe, indicating a fluidic connection to the suction pad.
features.refuted: The quote describes pressure regulation via tube and pipe but does not teach a grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate.

claims.note: The reference describes a suction gripping device and a transfer system, but not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device or a suction plate.

claims.quote: According to one embodiment, a suction gripping device includes a pad mechanism mounted to a base.
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction gripping device with a base (housing) and a vacuum generating device (pressure regulator), but it does not explicitly mention a grip portion for gripping the unit or that the vacuum generating device is electrically operated.
The reference does not describe the grip portion as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet, nor does it mention a sound-damping device.
This reference describes a suction gripping device for transferring workpieces, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
This reference does not disclose a grip portion being at least partially lined with a sound-damping material.
This reference does not describe a vacuum generating device being arranged completely in a first housing portion of a housing.
This reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in a housing portion or a housing portion lined with sound-reducing material.
This reference describes a suction gripping device and transfer system, but does not mention a grip unit, grip portion, or housing portions as described in this claim.
This reference describes a suction gripping device and transfer system, but does not mention an air collection device, air collection screw, or exhaust air as described in this claim.
This reference describes a suction gripping device and transfer system, but does not mention a grip portion, housing portion, air baffles, or air outlet as described in this claim.

This reference describes a suction gripping device and transfer system, but does not mention a battery coupling point, electrical energy storage device, rechargeable battery, or air baffles as described in this claim.
The reference does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.

claims.quote: According to one embodiment, a suction gripping device includes a pad mechanism mounted to a base.
claims.note: The reference describes a 'suction gripping device' which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a 'suction gripping device' and its components, not a 'vacuum handling apparatus comprising' as a whole. While related, it doesn't fully support the assertion of the apparatus itself.

claims.quote: The suction pad 11 has an attachment surface 11 a and is vacuum-attachable to the surface of the workpiece to be gripped.
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction pad (seal) and its attachment surface, but does not explicitly mention a carrier plate to which the seal is fastened or that the seal extends around the carrier plate.
This claim refers to 'the grip unit according to claim 1' of the subject invention, which is not provided in the reference text.
The reference describes a suction gripping device with a suction pad and a pipe, but it does not mention a grip unit or a coupling device for releasably connecting a grip unit and a suction plate.

claims.quote: The suction pad 11 has an attachment surface 11 a and is vacuum-attachable to the surface of the workpiece to be gripped.
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction pad that attaches to a workpiece via vacuum, implying a suction chamber and opening. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' with a suction opening or a 'suction chamber delimited by the suction plate'.

overall.why: This reference discloses essentially the same invention as described in the claims, including the core elements of a suction gripping device with a sliding part, tiltable suction pad, and lock mechanisms, as well as a transfer system and method utilizing these features.
